meta.title: Chubby fish studio
meta.description: A painting canvas in the right sidebar that you share with the agent. Open it from 🐟 肥鱼画室 at the foot of the left sidebar. It sees your painting and paints on it one stroke at a time — every stroke it makes is undoable, and it has to look before it paints. Real pigment mixing, six brushes, a built-in recorder. One canvas per conversation: no layers and no eraser.
